title: Woman with Two Dogs
description: A woman with dark hair in buns sits on a green sofa, gently touching a small black and tan dachshund while a large brown boxer rests its head on her lap. The stylized interior features rose-patterned walls, floating bubbles, scattered rose petals, and a retro cocktail table under a brass lamp.
prompt: A woman with dark hair styled in two buns with a green ribbon sits on a green mid-century sofa, wearing a red patterned dress. She is accompanied by a small black and tan dachshund sitting beside her and a large brown boxer dog resting its head on her lap. The room has rose-covered walls in pink and blue tones, floating transparent bubbles, red rose petals on the floor, a brass floor lamp, and a round coffee table with a martini glass. Stylized cinematic lighting, detailed textures, surreal domestic atmosphere.
